```
Getting Pages deployment status...
Error: Deployment failed, try again later.
```

It always happen after the first successful deployment.

Is this a bug of this action or internal problem with the github pages service?

```
Summary of the failure
- The Pages deployment was created (deployment id 978f7ae2ff0f96d143e169a4016125b81fc3d771) but immediately failed with: "Deployment failed, try again later."
- The job log shows the Pages action set page_url but preview_url is empty and the action exited with code 1.
- This means the GitHub Pages service rejected or could not complete the publish step (common causes: missing build artifact, Pages service error, custom-domain / DNS / TLS issue, or insufficient workflow permissions).
```

But if I'm re-running all jobs, not only deploy, it works. I guess artifacts expired since yesterday.

Also hitting this on a completely fresh, non-concurrent push — single artifact uploaded, `concurrency: { group: "pages", cancel-in-progress: false }` set, nothing else running at the time: https://github.com/cansenk/iman-availability/actions/runs/28707736188

One nuance that might help others debugging this: re-running the deploy job *after* it already got past the artifact upload once can produce a second identically-named `github-pages` artifact, which then fails with a different, fully deterministic error ("Multiple artifacts named \"github-pages\" were unexpectedly found for this workflow run. Artifact count is 2.") — easy to mistake for a continuation of this same bug when it's actually a separate, self-inflicted issue from re-running in place.

Workaround that's been reliable for us: (1) never re-run the failed run in place — push a new commit or use workflow_dispatch instead, and (2) add automatic retries scoped to just the deploy step (never re-touching the upload step), similar to what others here have already done.

I hit a similar `actions/deploy-pages@v5` failure in a repository using GitHub Pages’ “Deploy from a branch” mode.

In short, my Pages settings were:

- Source: `Deploy from a branch`
- Branch: `gh-pages`
- Path: `/`
- `build_type`: `legacy`

The GitHub-generated `pages-build-deployment` workflow failed at `actions/deploy-pages@v5` with:

```text
Getting Pages deployment status...
Error: Deployment failed, try again later.
```

Re-applying the same Pages branch settings through the REST API, then pushing a fresh commit to the selected Pages branch, recovered my repository:

```bash
gh api -X PUT repos/OWNER/REPO/pages \
  -f build_type=legacy \
  -f 'source[branch]=gh-pages' \
  -f 'source[path]=/'
```

After that, I triggered my publishing workflow so it pushed a new commit to `gh-pages`, and the GitHub-created `pages-build-deployment` workflow succeeded again.

I posted the detailed recovery steps and observations here:
https://github.com/orgs/community/discussions/200823#discussioncomment-17536335

I’m sharing this as a data point because the visible failure happens at `actions/deploy-pages@v5`, but the underlying cause may be stale or inconsistent GitHub Pages state for repositories using branch-based Pages deployment. For people who cannot switch permanently to “GitHub Actions” as the Pages source, re-applying the same branch source settings through the Pages API may be a useful workaround.

I had the same frustrating symptom.  

### TLDR: force a rebuild bypassing stuck workflows  
From [Marjorie Roswell](https://github.com/mroswell):  
```
gh api -X POST /repos/OWNER/REPO/pages/builds
```

### Supporting Info.  
I tried the work-around from [Marjorie Roswell](https://github.com/mroswell) at: [community/discussions: failed deployment #200883](https://github.com/orgs/community/discussions/200883#discussioncomment-17526238).  See [her posts](https://github.com/orgs/community/discussions/200883#discussioncomment-17526238).  

It worked on my initial attempt:  
```
gh api -X POST /repos/mccright/rrl_staging/pages/builds
```
In ~40 seconds the github-pages site deployed.  

Thank you [mroswell](https://github.com/mroswell)!

I've got more failures than successes for my open-source project https://github.com/svrooij/node-sonos-ts/deployments

I switched from Deploy from branch to GitHub actions as the source but the deploys keep failing and some succeed, with the same configuration

Can confirm that the work-around posted by @mroswell and posted here by @mccright worked for me as well.

Doesn't take away anything from the fact that the legacy build workflow should still be fixed. This is only a work-around after all.
Also experiencing this issue since the 3rd of July. Republishing the page to forces it to show the latest branch data but then fails over on next refresh.

Update: In my repository the issue resolved itself the next day without any code or workflow changes.

During the failure period, the build and artifact upload succeeded, but deploy-pages kept failing with:

Error: Deployment failed, try again later.

A day later, deployments started working again normally.

Thanks everyone for the suggestions.
